svg.text: Fresh water from our own barge, crew boats arranged as your agent,
and full ship agency at Khorfakkan and Fujairah.
Running low on fresh water should never hold a ship up. Malik, our own
water barge, brings drinking water out to vessels at Khorfakkan and
Fujairah. Because we own the barge, we plan the delivery around your
ship, not around someone else's timetable.
02 · One team for the port call
A port call has many moving parts. As your agent at Khorfakkan and Fujairah,
we are the one team that owners, operators and masters deal with, from the
first ETA message to the moment the ship sails.
We don't own crew boats, and we don't pretend to. As your agent, we
book the right boat for the job at Khorfakkan or Fujairah, plan it around
your ship and stay with it until everyone and everything is where it
